name: feature-workflow
description: On-demand feature skills for Claude Code: /feature recommends a workflow (DIRECT, SDD or EVO) and runs it as orchestrator of several features or executor of one, with classified skills you can extend per user, repository or module; /feature-kit loads the same skills for hand-driven work.
